what_is_cs.title: What is couch surfing?
what_is_cs.description_1: Couch surfing is a concept where some members (called hosts) post on the platform, stating they are open to hosting other members (called surfers) who are visiting their city.
what_is_cs.description_2: It’s like having a friend in another city and going to visit them, but you meet the friend for the first time once you get there!
what_is_cs.get_involved_title: What can I do on Couchers.org?
what_is_cs.timeline_title: A quick history of couch surfing

timeline.early_2000s_text: The online couch surfing movement is born: stay with locals, share culture.
timeline.2010s_text: Communities and events flourish; references build trust — the world starts to feel like one friendly neighborhood.
timeline.2020_text: A major platform goes for‑profit; Couchers.org launches as the nonprofit, community‑run alternative.
timeline.today_text: Couchers.org builds the next chapter: modern, safer, non-profit couch surfing — built by and for the community.

is_it_safe.title: How safe is Couch surfing?
is_it_safe.description_1: While all travel and interaction with strangers carries some risk, couch surfing is a lot safer than many people initially imagine.
is_it_safe.description_2: Our community is built on trust between members, established through references following stays. Our active moderation team takes every report seriously and diligently counters bad actors who do not abide by our <guidelines>Community Guidelines</guidelines>.
is_it_safe.description_3: Additionally, the Couchers platform includes tools such as various forms of verification (like Strong Verification with a biometric passport) that add an additional level of safety. It’s important to always have an alternative plan ready in case things don’t go as expected, and to trust your instincts!

team.title: The Team
team.description: We are passionate couch surfers and skilled professionals committed to creating an improved, safer, and more inclusive platform. We are building this platform to support and sustainably grow the couch surfing community while sharing its values with the world. If you share our sentiments and want to contribute, we would love to hear from you.
